title: Differentially Private Bagging Ensemble with Adaptive Privacy Budgeting for Credit Card Fraud Detection
content: This paper studies credit card fraud detection under strong differential privacy constraints. It proposes \textbf{PrivBagging‑Net (PBN)}, which is a noise-aware ensemble framework. PBN builds several base models using bootstrap sampling and random feature subspaces to get diverse and uncorrelated learners. Each model, including LightGBM, CatBoost, and deep neural network, is trained separately. Each uses a privacy budget and a noise method that fits its type, so it satisfies differential privacy. To combine these models, PBN uses a noise-adaptive aggregator. This aggregator gives weights to models based on their out-of-bag scores using a softmax function. A privacy scheduler also adjusts privacy budgets based on model performance. This keeps the total budget within a set limit. PBN uses separate noise injection, model combination, and budget scheduling to improve stability and generalization under privacy constraints.
